semantics.explanation: The two streams represent the same execution with complementary prices, opposite directions and different tids. Do not sum side quantities, count two executions, or add both quote notionals into primary-book turnover.
semantics.firstPartyConvention: Outcome-list rows select token.outcomeTokens[0].dayNtlVlm. A selected side's trading view uses its own context.dayNtlVlm. Hunch market rows consistently use side 0, matching the canonical_primary_trades ledger.
